gloss_en: the three colors of the eye together with the pupil (bat ayin) — the Zoharic/kabbalistic aspect of the eye's components (tlat gevanin de-eina u-vat ayin), drawn from the four-letter Divine Name and corresponding to the mochin, the power of sight, and the letters of Shabbat (shin = three colors, bat = pupil), as expounded in Likutey Moharan II:67
